detail.longDescription: I got tired of copying context between Claude Code, Codex and Gemini, so I built kywai. You ask once, a coordinator makes a plan, each agent takes the task it's best at, and a model from a different provider reviews every change before you see it. Per-task undo, local models via LM Studio/Ollama, Android app. Free and open source (MIT), for Windows, macOS and Linux. https:// kywai.app https:// github.com/Yiku21/kywai # opensource # AIagents # ClaudeCode # buildinpublic
